project.title: Frozen one-shot pose robustness
project.researchQuestion: Does the full contextual training recipe reduce one-shot retrieval degradation relative to a standard contrastive recipe when only novel pose queries are corrupted?
project.summary: Final v3 December study: frozen MotionBERT, three training recipes, three paired seeds, 20 epochs, and nine query-only corruption conditions. Three engineering pilots precede 27 selection runs, nine fresh final heads, and 180 locked evaluation cells. Implementation, measured capacity, and test-opening gates remain prerequisites; null or negative results are valid outcomes.

experimentalDesign.label: Dataset and episode
experimentalDesign.value: Bind 113,945 usable HRNet annotations plus 535 official missing-skeleton exclusions (114,480 nominal captures), source hashes and the frozen checkpoint. Preserve the existing 80-action development-training / 20-action validation split, official 20 novel actions, all official exemplars and the exact historical development anchor/query identities.

experimentalDesign.label: Selection and final data
experimentalDesign.value: Use 76,013 training rows, 20 clean gallery references and 18,929 primary queries for development. Final training uses all 100 auxiliary actions and 95,001 rows. No training-subset contingency or novel outcome access is allowed.

experimentalDesign.label: Two query definitions
experimentalDesign.value: Primary queries exclude each clean gallery sample and every synchronized view of its underlying performance, keyed by setup, performer, repetition and action. The exact-official secondary set excludes only the exemplar. Verify and lock the exact ordered lists: expected novel counts are 18,884 primary and 18,924 exact-official queries.

experimentalDesign.label: Deterministic inputs
experimentalDesign.value: Use the adopted float32 tensor with two people, 100 frames, 17 H36M joints and x/y/confidence channels. Keep camera normalization, tracking, joint conversion, uniform temporal sampling, padding and spatial normalization fixed. Random movement is off; compare encoder parity on the same locally corrected confidence tensor.

experimentalDesign.label: Contrastive recipe
experimentalDesign.value: Standard cosine-margin contrastive loss with positive margin 0.9 and negative margin 0.6. Average positive and negative strictly active hinges separately; empty active sets contribute zero.

experimentalDesign.label: Contextual recipe
experimentalDesign.value: 0.4 L_context + 0.6 L_contrast + 0.1 L_reg, positive/negative margins 0.75/0.6, neighborhood 4, epsilon 0.05, STE alpha 10 and target mean similarity 0.25. Implement the same-label target in Equation 5 and independently verify labeled forward/backward fixtures. These fixed transfer settings are pose-study adaptations, not proven optima.

experimentalDesign.label: SupCon recipe
experimentalDesign.value: Single-view supervised positive log-softmax at temperature 0.07 with no extra temperature multiplier. It is a required descriptive comparator, not a second confirmatory superiority test.

experimentalDesign.label: Optimizer and sampling
experimentalDesign.value: Float32 features and parameters; constant-rate AdamW, betas (0.9, 0.999), epsilon 1e-8, amsgrad false, weight decay 1e-4 on both weight and bias. No scheduler, mixed precision, clipping or augmentation. Epochs contain ceil(N/32) physical batches under archived paired sample plans; this is a balanced sampling budget, not one visit per sample.

experimentalDesign.label: Engineering pilots
experimentalDesign.value: One full 20-epoch pilot per arm, seed 7 and learning rate 3e-4. Retain immutable checkpoints and complete clean development scores at epochs 5, 10, 15 and 20, plus epoch-zero diagnostics. Require mathematical/learnable-fixture checks, finite updates, nonzero vectors and no total numerical collapse. Pilots are ineligible for selection; real-data accuracy has no acceptance floor.

experimentalDesign.label: Learning-rate selection
experimentalDesign.value: For each arm attempt rates 1e-4, 3e-4 and 1e-3 with all three seeds: 27 fresh 20-epoch development runs. Rank by unrounded mean epoch-20 clean development top-1, then mean MRR, then lower rate. A candidate needs all three valid seeds. Preserve failures and disclose unequal eligibility; an arm with no valid candidate blocks the campaign.

experimentalDesign.label: Fresh final heads
experimentalDesign.value: Lock the selected rate for each arm and selection evidence, then train nine fresh heads on all 95,001 auxiliary rows for 20 epochs. Keep epoch-20 weights; do not reuse pilot or selection heads. Infrastructure retries restart identical settings in new immutable attempt directories. Corrections rerun every affected comparison under the amendment policy.

experimentalDesign.label: Fresh caches and evaluation
experimentalDesign.value: Create v3-bound manifests with unchanged identities and fresh clean caches, including parity and two repeat extractions on the same GPU. Encode the union of novel queries once per condition, then export verified immutable primary and exact-official cache files. All nine heads share pre-head caches: the encoder workload is one clean gallery plus ten query conditions, not 180 encoder passes.

experimentalDesign.label: Metrics
experimentalDesign.value: Use cosine retrieval with a fixed gallery order for ties and query-weighted top-1, MRR and R@5. With one relevant exemplar, mAP equals MRR. Report all methods, seeds, clean/corrupted cells and both query definitions, alongside actual resource costs and retained failures.

protocol.corruptionPrinciple: Apply each family independently to clean, fully preprocessed query tensors before the frozen encoder; keep the gallery clean. Derive a per-sample family seed from SHA-256 of protocol-v3, sample ID and family, excluding severity. Share the realized corruptions across methods/seeds and nest severities. These are synthetic tensor stress tests, not measured camera occlusion or pose-estimator shifts.

corruptions.label: Coordinate jitter
corruptions.value: Reuse one seeded CPU float32 Gaussian x/y field at 1%, 2.5% and 5% of clean torso scale. Add noise only where original confidence is positive; leave confidence and missing/padded observations unchanged. Do not clip or renormalize.

corruptions.label: Joint or limb masking
corruptions.value: Shuffle the fixed ordered limb groups once per sample; take the first 3, 6 or 8 joint trajectories from that same ordering. Zero x/y/confidence across all people and frames, with exact nested masks. Already absent joints are not replaced by visible ones.

corruptions.label: Consecutive-frame masking
corruptions.value: For L = 10, 25 or 40, use start = floor(u × (101 − L) / 2^64), where u is the first eight hash bytes as an unsigned big-endian integer. Zero the consecutive block across people, joints and channels. Blocks are nested; no frames are deleted, resampled or interpolated.

corruptions.label: Scale and fallback
corruptions.value: Use the lower median positive finite shoulder-to-hip midpoint distance among clean observations with four positive source confidences. If a sample lacks a scale, use the fixed lower median of valid sample-level scales from the 80-action training set only. Freeze its value, contributing IDs/count/hash before pilots; never recompute it from validation or novel data.

corruptions.label: Identity and geometry checks
corruptions.value: Severity zero is byte-identical to clean input. Verify exact counts, nesting, shared jitter, missingness, boundary frames, two-person cases, fallback and fresh-process reproducibility on a fixed development panel. Record effective damage, zero-damage cases and fallback frequency; never redraw corruption or drop a troublesome novel query.

corruptions.label: Preselection verification
corruptions.value: By October 18 complete all nine full-size development query paths. Time a maximum-severity pass per family through source checks, preprocessing, encoding, storage, projection of three pilot heads and full retrieval. Corrupted development scores may validate the evaluator but cannot choose settings, severities, rates or duration.

protocol.primaryFormula: drop(method, seed, cell) = clean_top1(method, seed) − corrupted_top1(method, seed, cell)
protocol.effectFormula: Delta = mean over the three fixed seeds and nine corruption cells of [drop(Contextual, seed, cell) − drop(Contrastive, seed, cell)]. Negative Delta means less degradation for the full contextual recipe.
analysisRules: The primary estimand uses the primary query set. Queries have equal weight within a cell; all three seeds and all nine cells have equal weight. The nine-cell mixture is prespecified synthetic stress, not real-world corruption prevalence.

Average the paired correctness-drop difference over the fixed seeds and cells for each query. Cluster by setup, performer, repetition and action. Independently within each of the 20 fixed actions, resample its original number of performance groups with replacement, retaining all camera views and multiplicities.

Apply the same cluster draw to every method, seed and condition; divide the summed effects by the sampled query count. Do not equally weight unequal-view groups or force equal action weights. Do not resample seeds or actions.

Use 10,000 bootstrap replicates from numpy Generator(PCG64(2026)), with a two-sided 95% percentile interval and linear 0.025/0.975 quantiles. Freeze and test the analysis before selection; rehash it at opening.

The interval is conditional on the trained heads, three seeds, fixed official actions/anchors, query definitions and realized corruptions. It assumes exchangeable performance groups within each action; it does not quantify arbitrary seed/action/participant/anchor or real-camera variation.

Support the single confirmatory statement of smaller clean-to-corrupt top-1 degradation only if the interval upper bound is below zero. Otherwise report a null or contrary result. Always show clean and absolute corrupted accuracy and the descriptive Contextual-minus-Contrastive corrupted-accuracy difference; smaller degradation need not mean better corrupted retrieval.

Report all three seed effects, nine cell effects/curves and 20 leave-one-action-out effects. For each sensitivity, remove only that action’s query observations while keeping all 20 gallery anchors and original ranks. Report range and sign changes descriptively, without new tests.

SupCon, exact-official queries, individual cells, seed variation and sensitivities are descriptive. No extra superiority tests, selected winning cells or unique causal attribution to contextual neighborhoods. Report the effects of margins and regularization as part of the full recipe.

Missing, invalid or unbound cells prevent a complete report. Keep every attempt and preserve the test-opening record after a crash. Post-opening scientific or implementation corrections must be disclosed as deviations; they cannot silently replace the confirmatory pipeline.
scopeExclusions: The regularizer-only control is omitted before new pilot or selection scores as a scope/capacity decision, not a negative experimental result.
The 26-method v2 benchmark, encoder fine-tuning, Multi-Similarity, extra datasets, alternative batch sizes and real pose-estimator shifts are future studies; v3 does not complete v2.
No altered split, corruption, metric, duration, recipe, selected epoch or claim after novel outcomes. No partial-seed candidate, training-subset shortcut or silent omission of required methods/cells.
No universal robustness, real-camera occlusion, participant-generalization, raw-video, identity, clinical or biomechanical claims.

No copied unlicensed contextual code, new repository-wide license without authorization, licensed poses, checkpoints, caches, full artifacts, credentials or private governance records in Git or public tracker exports.

weeks.deliverable: A complete selection ledger and timestamped three-recipe selection decision by November 1.
risks: A numerical failure makes a candidate ineligible until resolved; each selected candidate needs all three valid seeds.
An arm with no valid candidate requires a result-blind amendment, not an alternate recipe or reduced seed count.
weeks.advisorPrompt: Can an independent replay reproduce every selected rate from the complete unrounded clean development records?

tasks.title: Finish the declared selection matrix
tasks.details: Complete and account for every arm × rate × seed attempt at 20 epochs. Preserve all numerical failures and identical infrastructure retries; never silently omit a setting or replace its budget.
tasks.expectedOutput: A complete 27-setting attempt ledger with valid-run and failure status.

tasks.title: Reproduce candidate ranking
tasks.details: Within each arm rank eligible three-seed candidates by mean epoch-20 clean top-1, then mean MRR, then lower learning rate, using unrounded metrics. Report unequal numbers of eligible candidates.
tasks.expectedOutput: An independently reproducible candidate table with tie and eligibility decisions.

tasks.title: Lock the selected configurations
tasks.details: Bind the three selected rates, full evidence, attempt provenance and timestamp to the unchanged protocol. If any arm has no valid candidate, stop and document the amendment.
tasks.expectedOutput: A timestamped selection lock for all three recipes, or an explicit blocker.

tasks.title: Prepare all-auxiliary final training
tasks.details: Verify the fresh 95,001-row v3 cache and generate paired all-100-action batch plans and initial states for seeds 7, 17 and 29. Recheck capacity and complete-run allocation limits.
tasks.expectedOutput: Nine fresh final-run specifications and updated capacity evidence.

gates.criterion: All 27 declared selection settings have an accounted attempt; every selected candidate has three valid seeds.
The three selected rates reproduce under the exact unrounded ranking rule and are immutably recorded before final training.
Final training inputs, paired plans and allocation/capacity checks pass for all nine fresh heads.

weeks.title: Train the nine final heads
weeks.objective: Train the selected recipes from fresh paired initialization on all 100 auxiliary actions.
weeks.deliverable: Authorized final training attempts toward nine 20-epoch heads with immutable provenance and epoch-20 weights.
risks: Development or pilot heads cannot be reused as final heads.
Complete runs must fit approved allocations; partial attempts remain retained and cannot become resumable selection shortcuts.
weeks.advisorPrompt: Are the final heads fresh, paired and bound to the selected clean-development recipes and all-auxiliary data?

tasks.title: Validate all-auxiliary inputs
tasks.details: Revalidate source/checkpoint hashes, all 95,001 sample identities, fresh cache sidecars and locked selected rates before final training.
tasks.expectedOutput: A verified final-input and configuration manifest.

tasks.title: Train paired final recipes
tasks.details: Run Contrastive, Contextual and SupCon for 20 epochs with seeds 7, 17 and 29 on all 100 auxiliary actions. Pair head initialization and physical batch plans; retain only the prescribed epoch-20 final choice.
tasks.expectedOutput: Immutable final attempts with exact 59,380 updates per complete head.

tasks.title: Record final health and cost
tasks.details: Preserve finite-parameter checks, normalization diagnostics, timing, memory, saved bytes, initialization/batch hashes and the complete attempt history. Do not inspect novel inputs or outcomes.
tasks.expectedOutput: Per-head health, pairing, cost and provenance records.

tasks.title: Review remaining final workload
tasks.details: Track remaining heads against the measured allocation calendar and capacity formula, retaining failed outputs and at least 25% remaining-work slack.
tasks.expectedOutput: An updated remaining-work forecast that preserves the final-lock deadline.

gates.criterion: Every final attempt begins fresh and matches its selected rate, all-100-action inputs, paired seed and 20-epoch budget.
All completed heads have immutable epoch-20 checkpoints and valid health, pairing and provenance evidence.
Novel retrieval inputs and outcomes remain sealed while final training and any identical retries continue.

weeks.title: Complete and verify final heads
weeks.objective: Finish and independently verify all nine final heads by November 15.
weeks.deliverable: Nine valid final checkpoints and complete final-run evidence ready for independent lock audit.
risks: One missing or invalid required head blocks final opening.
Corrections before opening require a dated result-blind decision and rerunning all affected comparisons.
weeks.advisorPrompt: Are all nine heads complete, correctly paired and independently verifiable without any novel-data access?

tasks.title: Complete remaining final attempts
tasks.details: Finish all three recipes × three seeds on all 95,001 auxiliary rows. Retain every prior attempt and restart infrastructure failures only with identical inputs and settings.
tasks.expectedOutput: All nine complete 20-epoch final heads or a visible blocker.

tasks.title: Audit checkpoint and manifest integrity
tasks.details: Verify every checkpoint hash, source/input contract, protocol/config/code/dependency binding, paired initialization/batches and exact update count. Confirm pilot and development heads are absent from the final set.
tasks.expectedOutput: A complete nine-head integrity and provenance report.

tasks.title: Build the final evaluation manifest
tasks.details: Freeze clean gallery order and exact primary/exact-official query lists from metadata. Declare all three methods × three seeds × ten conditions × two query definitions and every expected artifact role.
tasks.expectedOutput: A fixed 180-cell evaluation matrix with exact ordered identities and role contracts.

tasks.title: Confirm the audit schedule
tasks.details: Reserve November 16-29 for independent evaluator/run-set/lock checks, report templates and recovery. Update allocation and storage forecasts before any opening decision.
tasks.expectedOutput: A feasible final-audit and evaluation calendar with recorded capacity evidence.

gates.criterion: All nine final heads are complete and valid at epoch 20, with no selected checkpoint or configuration dependent on novel outcomes.
The exact query/gallery identities and 180 unique evaluation cells are fixed and cross-bound to the complete final-run set.
The independent audit and evaluation schedule preserves November 29 locks, December 6 results and December 7-18 delivery work.

weeks.title: Audit the evaluator and final run set
weeks.objective: Independently validate final provenance, authorization and result completeness using development evidence.
weeks.deliverable: A reviewed final-run set, evaluator/analysis verification and report/figure templates prepared without novel outcomes.
risks: Novel loader authorization must precede deserialization; shared dataset seals cannot be bypassed by legacy commands or namespaces.
A changed protocol digest or cache-affecting defect invalidates affected artifacts and requires documented rework.
weeks.advisorPrompt: Can the complete final campaign be authorized and reproduced without bypassing seal, identity or provenance checks?

tasks.title: Audit the evaluator end to end
tasks.details: Verify hand-ranked metrics, deterministic ties, both query definitions, cache subset identity, all-head projection and the expected 180-cell completeness rules using permitted fixtures and development data.
tasks.expectedOutput: An independent evaluator and completeness-verifier report.

tasks.title: Verify dataset-wide opening controls
tasks.details: Test cross-version denial, historical-root audit resolution, authorization before novel loading, concurrent first-opening behavior and fail-closed recovery of partial opening transactions.
tasks.expectedOutput: Passing v1/v2/v3 seal and first-opening safety checks.

tasks.title: Audit and assemble final locks
tasks.details: Cross-check nine final heads, selected settings, exact IDs, source/checkpoint/input hashes, code/dependency hashes and the evaluation plan before recording the researcher-controlled final lock.
tasks.expectedOutput: An independently checked complete final-run set and staged final-lock evidence.

tasks.title: Prepare report and figure templates
tasks.details: Rehearse clean/corrupted accuracy, degradation, conditional intervals, seed/cell/leave-one-action-out tables and costs from development or fixture records. Mark examples as non-final.
tasks.expectedOutput: Reproducible report/figure templates ready for locked final results.

gates.criterion: The evaluator, role-specific caches, metrics and 180-cell verifier pass independent development/fixture checks.
Shared seal enforcement and authorization-before-loading checks pass across all scientific entrypoints.
The final-run set and lock dependencies cross-bind all nine heads, exact identities and unchanged scientific settings.

weeks.title: Finish locks and preserve recovery time
weeks.objective: Complete all final-head and lock audits by November 29 while preserving Thanksgiving as recovery time.
weeks.deliverable: A complete final authorization package and current capacity/seal evidence for the following week’s single novel campaign.
risks: Reaching the date does not authorize opening; every final dependency and current resource check must pass.
Thanksgiving is recovery capacity, not permission to compress or skip independent verification.
weeks.advisorPrompt: Are all nine heads and every opening prerequisite verified, with sufficient current capacity for the complete campaign?

tasks.title: Resolve pre-opening audit findings
tasks.details: Correct verified pre-opening defects through documented result-blind decisions, rerunning all affected artifacts/comparisons where required. Preserve superseded evidence.
tasks.expectedOutput: An audit ledger with no unresolved final-opening blocker.

tasks.title: Complete final locks by November 29
tasks.details: Bind the nine checkpoints/run manifests, selected configurations, exact gallery/query lists, evaluation plan and source/protocol/code dependencies in the complete final lock. Confirm no scientific training remains active.
tasks.expectedOutput: The complete immutable final lock and final-run-set record.

tasks.title: Repeat seal and capacity audits
tasks.details: Recheck every registered historical root and release, filesystem/quota limits, forecast remaining peak bytes, allocation and opening recovery procedure. A missing or unreadable root blocks opening.
tasks.expectedOutput: Current resolved seal and capacity reports for the authorized source.

tasks.title: Preserve recovery and handoff readiness
tasks.details: Use the reduced Thanksgiving work budget for required recovery and rehearse the authorized campaign checklist. If prerequisites cannot pass, keep the seal and record a dated blocker/amendment.
tasks.expectedOutput: A ready or explicitly blocked evaluation handoff with no invented completion.

gates.criterion: All nine final heads and the complete final lock are verified by November 29; no scientific training is active.
Current historical-root, source, allocation and storage checks pass for the entire final evaluation campaign.
The novel test remains unopened until the single authorized campaign; unresolved requirements are visible blockers.

weeks.title: Open once and evaluate all 180 cells
weeks.objective: Run one fully authorized novel extraction and evaluation campaign by December 6.
weeks.deliverable: All 180 unique finite provenance-valid result cells and locked per-query ranks, with every operational attempt retained.
risks: Opening is irreversible: a failed process does not reseal data or permit new training and selection.
Missing or invalid cells block a complete report; post-opening corrections require explicit deviation reporting.
weeks.advisorPrompt: Does every required final cell reproduce from the same authorized source, opening, protocol, caches and checkpoint set?

tasks.title: Validate and atomically authorize opening
tasks.details: Revalidate all lock bindings and prior ledgers, confirm no training is active, and recheck capacity. Atomically record the shared dataset opening and v3 authorization before invoking the novel annotation loader.
tasks.expectedOutput: One immutable dataset-opening event bound to the complete v3 final lock.

tasks.title: Extract the final novel conditions
tasks.details: Encode one clean gallery and the novel query union for clean plus nine corruptions. Export two immutable role-specific query caches per condition and verify that primary rows are the exact ordered subset of exact-official rows.
tasks.expectedOutput: Authorized deterministic caches for both query definitions with complete corruption and source provenance.

tasks.title: Evaluate all heads and cells
tasks.details: Apply all nine final heads to the clean gallery and every query role/condition. Produce top-1, MRR, R@5 and per-query ranks for three methods × three seeds × ten conditions × two query definitions.
tasks.expectedOutput: 180 unique finite result cells and their checkpoint-bound per-query evidence.

tasks.title: Verify campaign completeness
tasks.details: Independently regenerate cell metrics from ranks, validate every cross-binding and retain all failures/retries. Retry only the identical authorized operations; preserve any post-opening defect as a disclosed limitation.
tasks.expectedOutput: A complete final evaluation audit or an explicit incomplete/deviation record.

gates.criterion: The immutable dataset opening precedes all novel loading and binds the complete final authorization.
All 180 required result cells are finite, unique, provenance-valid and reproducible from locked per-query evidence.
No scientific training/selection occurs after opening; all operational attempts and any deviations remain visible.

weeks.title: Analyze and report the declared study
weeks.objective: Produce the conditional primary analysis and complete descriptive report with accurate recipe-level claims.
weeks.deliverable: Reproducible conditional interval, absolute accuracy/degradation curves, seed/cell/action sensitivities, resource tables and report/poster draft.
risks: Less degradation can coexist with lower absolute corrupted accuracy; both must be reported.
The interval is conditional on fixed heads, seeds, actions, anchors and corruptions, and cannot support universal robustness or a contextual-term-only causal claim.
weeks.advisorPrompt: Do the claims follow the single prespecified interval rule while showing absolute performance, uncertainty limits and all required descriptive results?

tasks.title: Compute the locked primary analysis
tasks.details: Run 10,000 within-action performance-cluster bootstrap replicates with fixed seeds/actions and query-weighted multiplicities. Report Delta and its 95% percentile interval; claim smaller degradation only if the upper bound is below zero.
tasks.expectedOutput: A reproducible conditional primary estimate/interval and positive, null or contrary conclusion.

tasks.title: Publish complete descriptive results
tasks.details: Show clean and absolute corrupted accuracy, Contextual-minus-Contrastive corrupted differences, every seed/cell effect, SupCon, exact-official results and 20 leave-one-action-out sensitivities with a fixed gallery.
tasks.expectedOutput: All prespecified tables and curves, including sign changes and conditional limits.

tasks.title: Write the report and poster
tasks.details: Explain the frozen encoder, fixed transfer recipes, nested synthetic corruptions, selection, test seal, resource costs and retained failures. State that margins/regularization are part of the recipe and that v3 does not complete the v2 benchmark.
tasks.expectedOutput: A report/poster draft with claims traceable to locked evidence and honest scope limits.

tasks.title: Regenerate figures and resolve review findings
tasks.details: Reproduce every table and figure from immutable ranks/manifests, resolve presentation/reproducibility defects and explicitly label any post-opening scientific deviation.
tasks.expectedOutput: A reviewed reproduction log and permitted compact final evidence package.

gates.criterion: The conditional primary interval and all prespecified descriptive outputs regenerate from the locked records.
The confirmatory statement follows the upper-bound-below-zero rule; absolute accuracy and recipe-level/conditional limitations accompany it.
The report includes all methods, seeds, cells, costs and failures without outcome-driven omissions or new superiority tests.

weeks.title: Deliver and archive the December study
weeks.objective: Deliver the final report/poster and recoverable permitted evidence by December 18.
weeks.deliverable: Final report/poster, independent reproduction smoke test, public-safe archive and reconciled tracker; if blocked, an explicit incomplete-study record.
risks: Licensed data, checkpoints, caches, full artifacts and private governance records must remain outside Git and public exports.
A blocked or incomplete campaign cannot be presented as a completed empirical comparison.
weeks.advisorPrompt: Can a reader reproduce every permitted result and distinguish completed evidence, limitations and any unresolved work?

tasks.title: Run the independent reproduction smoke test
tasks.details: Reproduce permitted summaries and report outputs from the locked evidence, verify artifact references and document software/hardware requirements and operational limitations.
tasks.expectedOutput: An independent reproduction record for the final deliverables.

tasks.title: Finalize the report and poster
tasks.details: Deliver the December report/poster with the full primary/descriptive results, recipe-level interpretation, conditional uncertainty, failures, costs and limitations. If the campaign is blocked, state the missing evidence and amendment explicitly.
tasks.expectedOutput: Final report/poster or an honest dated blocked-study report.

tasks.title: Archive permitted material
tasks.details: Preserve source, versioned configs, manifests, compact summaries, license notices and reproduction instructions. Keep historical artifacts recoverable without overwriting them and exclude licensed/private material from Git.
tasks.expectedOutput: A recoverable license-safe release and evidence index.

tasks.title: Reconcile and export the tracker
tasks.details: Verify live website, fallback, protocol and schedule consistency; preserve hosted evidence/versions and closed-week history. Record actual time only when supplied by the researcher and export only public-safe fields.
tasks.expectedOutput: A verified public tracker/export and researcher-supplied retrospective/time record where available.

gates.criterion: The final report/poster and required outputs are delivered by December 18, or the incomplete study and dated amendment are explicitly recorded.
All nine final heads, 180 cells and declared analyses are independently evidenced before claiming empirical completion.
Source, permitted evidence and reproduction instructions are recoverable and exclude licensed/private material.
The live tracker/export matches v3 while preserving historical progress and actual hours without invented completions.
